effects: The signer pays the auction's current Dutch-auction price in the auction's debt token. The contract pulls it with safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, AuctionHouse, currentPrice). Both the token and the price come from storage and drop over time down to a floor.
The AuctionHouse approves the VaultManager for that payment and calls finalizeAuction(nftId, collateralSatsForSale, currentPrice). This repays the vault's debt with the signer's tokens.
The signer is recorded as the auction winner (winnerEvm = msg.sender). Their BTC payout address (btcAddress_) is stored, and an admin later delivers collateralSatsForSale satoshis to it off-chain.
No ETH is taken. The function is not payable.
formats.shown: The screen says 'Buy collateral of Surge vault 140' and shows the vault id and the BTC payout address as hex bytes. It does not show the payment token or the price.

findings.title: buy: the debt-token payment at the current auction price is never shown or named.
findings.evidence: AuctionHouseUpgradeable.sol buy(): `uint256 currentPrice = getCurrentPrice(nftId_); auction.token.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), currentPrice);`. The token and price come from storage (auctions[nftId_]). The descriptor intent 'Buy Surge auction collateral' has no field or word about payment. Under not_critical 3 this is a price read from storage while the driving input (the vault id) is shown, so it is info.
findings.fix: Name the payment in the intent, e.g. 'Buy collateral of Surge vault {nftId_}, paying its current auction price in the vault's debt token'. The token and amount cannot be shown because they are in storage.

findings.title: buy: the BTC payout address appears as hex bytes, not as the readable bech32 string.
findings.evidence: Descriptor field `btcAddress_` 'BTC payout (hex)' format raw. Case 0 shows 0x62633171617230...6d6471, which is ASCII for 'bc1qar0srrr7xfkvy5l643lydnw9re59gtzzwf5mdq'. The spec has no UTF-8 format for `bytes`, so the signer cannot easily check where the collateral will be sent.
findings.fix: None possible today. A UTF-8 display for bytes is needed in the spec. The label already warns that the value is hex.

findings.title: buy: the BTC collateral is delivered off-chain later by the admin, not in this transaction.
findings.evidence: buy() only stores `auction.winnerBtcAddress = btcAddress_`. Delivery is recorded later in confirmBtcDelivered(), which is onlyAdmin. The intent 'Buy collateral' does not say that nothing arrives on-chain.
findings.fix: Optionally add to the intent that the BTC is sent later to the given address.
